author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನ ಕಾರ್ಯವನೆಲ್ಲ ಲೋಕಕರ್ಪಣೆ ಗೈಯೆ
ಮನ್ನಣೆಯು ದೊರೆಯುವುದು ಸಾಧನೆಯ ಪಥಕೆ
ಕನ್ನಡಿಯ ಬಿಂಬ ನಿನ ಪ್ರತಿಫಲನ ಮಾಡುತಿರೆ
ಸನ್ನಿವೇಷವನರಿಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When you offer all your work to the world,
honour comes to the path of striving;
as the mirror's image gives you back yourself,
know the situation as it is, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Work done as an offering to the world earns its own recognition along the way. Like a mirror, the world reflects back what we bring to it; see things as they truly are.
